tool.name: GSASII Refinement Stage 1
tool.description: Tool to upload files for neutron powder diffraction analysis in GSASII and perform an initial Rietveld refinement
tool.command:
conda init bash && source ../home/.bashrc && conda activate GSASII && mkdir app && cd app/ && touch $output && mkdir portal && #for $cif_file in $cif_files ln -s $cif_file '$cif_file.element_identifier' && #end for #for $p in $powder ln -sf '$p.gsas_file' '$p.gsas_file.element_identifier' && ln -sf '$p.prm_file' '$p.prm_file.element_identifier' && #end for
python $__tool_directory__/gsas2_refinement_upload.py --cif-filenames #for $cif_file in $cif_files # '$cif_file.element_identifier' #end for # --gsas-filename #for $p in $powder # '$p.gsas_file.element_identifier' #end for # --instrument-params-filename #for $p in $powder # '$p.prm_file.element_identifier' #end for # --output-directory /portal > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)
tool.help: A tool to run a GSAS2 Rietveld refinement.
